description: LLM-judge rubric for non-deterministic quality dimensions (Readability, Answer-block extractability, Vernacular localization).

dimensions.name: answer_block_extractability
dimensions.criteria: Direct H2/H3 question heading followed immediately by a concise 40-50 word direct resolution paragraph suitable for AI snippet extraction.

dimensions.name: brand_voice_alignment
dimensions.criteria: Adherence to client tone, vocabulary, and EEAT guidelines with zero marketing fluff.

dimensions.name: vernacular_localization
dimensions.criteria: Authentic Hindi/Devanagari phrasing matching local search intent rather than literal machine translation.
